device: Intel Core i5-7300HQ (4 cores), 16 GB RAM, Windows 11 10.0.26200; Playwright Chromium 156.0.8078.4 (headless) and Microsoft Edge 155.0.4283.62 (headless), extension loaded from a local non-synced folder
basis: 0.4.7 (d632c6f): 100 warm + 100 wake + 10 restart samples per browser (Chromium measured twice). Edge: warm p95 495 ms / max 1090, wake p95 556 / max 1318, restart p95 2697. Chromium: warm p95 1237 / max 4790, wake p95 996 / max 2573, restart p95 5034 on the quiet run; a run started within a minute of the Edge suite with about 2 GB of free memory saw warm p95 3312 / max 6716. In every run the tail sits in the browser creating the popup window (open acknowledgement), not in extension code: in-popup p95 was 360-480 ms warm and 430-440 ms wake on the quiet runs.
protocol: Run each browser on its own on an otherwise idle machine with at least 3 GB of free memory and no other browser running; wait a minute after any other test suite; never from a OneDrive or other synced folder. A run outside this protocol is not a gate result.
note: End-to-end limits are set with headroom for browser-side window creation on this device; the in-popup limits are the regression guard for extension code (popup document start to protection state visible). Any failed or timed-out sample fails the gate. Recalibrate when the reference device or the browser builds change.
